metadata.agent_last_message:
The implementation is complete and fully verified. Summary of the final state:

**3,377 lines of Rust across 4 source files**, zero external dependencies, using only the standard library.

**All 9 test cases pass byte-exact** against reference BibTeX 0.99c output:
- `edge.bbl` (plain), `edge_alpha.bbl` (alpha) — edge cases: von names, crossref, et al, thesis, string macros, preamble
- `multi.bbl` (plain), `multi_alpha.bbl`, `multi_unsrt.bbl`, `multi_abbrv.bbl` — all 4 canonical styles
- `test.bbl` (plain) — basic single entry
- `crossref.bbl` — crossref field inheritance
- `aux_test.bbl` — aux file citation parsing

**Features implemented:**
- Complete .bib parser with @string macros, @preamble, @comment, and all delimiter styles
- Complete .bst parser with all 10 top-level commands
- Stack machine engine with all 37 built-in functions
- BibTeX name parsing (First/von/Last/Jr) with 0/1/2-comma forms
- format.name$ with piece specifications, abbreviation, and inter-token separator rules
- Output buffer with 79-column line wrapping (backward/forward scan)
- cmr10 character width table for width$
- change.case$ with title/lower/upper modes (colon-space sentinel for title mode)
- purify$ with special character handling and space collapsing
- text.length$ and text.prefix$ with brace-aware counting
- Crossref inheritance with cycle detection
- Stable sort by sort.key$
- JSON error and log output
- Exit codes 0/1/2
